instruction: Open the FlightAware flight tracker help and support page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the FAQ/help page on FlightAware. Simple navigation task with similar complexity to original. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_url_from_accessTree getter which extracts URL from accessibility tree without page reload
Metric is_expected_active_tab properly handles string URL input and compares against expected URL using compare_urls
Expected URL https://www.flightaware.com/about/faq correctly points to FlightAware's FAQ/help page
Complete coverage: verifying the active tab URL matches the FAQ page URL is sufficient to verify navigation task completion
Previous judgment was incorrect - it confused active_url_from_accessTree (no reload) with active_tab_info (reloads page)
The evaluator semantically and logically verifies that the user navigated to the FlightAware help and support page
